name: smwmusic-super-marisa-world-hills-volcano
title: Super Marisa World - Hills/Volcano
description:
World 3 theme from (oh boy!) the Touhou fan game Super Marisa World, which is, in fact, a parody to Super Mario World (hence the name). Like many fan games, it's unknown if ZUN knows about this game. Can fit on various themes.

This song was part of Wyatt's music pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.
